title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations and Documents of a Judicial Interpretation Nature Issued During the Period from January 1, 1980 to June 30, 1997 (Ninth Batch)

articles.content_en:
January 14, 2013  
Supreme People's Court  
Decision on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations and Documents of a Judicial Interpretation Nature Issued Between January 1, 1980 and June 30, 1997  
(Ninth Batch)  
Fa Shi [2013] No. 2  

In order to adapt to changes in the development of the situation and ensure the correct and unified application of national laws, and in accordance with relevant legal provisions and the actual needs of adjudication, the Supreme People's Court, together with relevant departments, has conducted a centralized review of judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature issued between January 1, 1980 and June 30, 1997. It is hereby decided to abolish 429 judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature issued between January 1, 1980 and June 30, 1997. The abolished judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature shall no longer apply from the date this decision takes effect; however, judgments and rulings previously made on relevant cases in accordance with the following judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature shall remain valid.  

Catalogue of Certain Judicial Interpretations and Documents of a Judicial Interpretation Nature Issued Between January 1, 1980 and June 30, 1997 That Are to Be Abolished (Ninth Batch)
